assertions.assertion: Calls .AddSaml() on the IdentityServer builder chain
assertions.rationale: Chain shows .AddSaml() followed by .AddInMemorySamlServiceProviders after AddTestUsers.

assertions.assertion: No separate NuGet package is added — SAML is built into Duende.IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: States 'no extra package' - SAML built into Duende.IdentityServer v8.

assertions.rationale: Uses new IndexedEndpoint { Location = "https://crm.contoso.com/saml/acs", Binding = SamlBinding.HttpPost }.
